Hi Tessa —

Thanks for walking us through the commercial terms yesterday. Our legal team asked for a couple of clarifications before we sign the order form:

1) Publicity/Reference rights: We prefer a narrow clause — Brightware approves press releases and public case studies; Redwood may request quotes but needs prior written approval for verbatim use.
2) Logo usage: We have strict brand guidelines and require an asset package sign-off plus a defined embargo window for announcements.
3) Confidentiality carve-outs: We need assurance that early access pilot data is treated as confidential and not referenced publicly.

Can you send the redline you intend to ship to our legal folks and confirm the approval flow (who signs off, timing)? We are on a tight timeline — hoping to close this week.

Thanks,

Tessa —

Draft language below that should be acceptable and keeps Brightware comfortable without broad marketing commitments from us. I'd recommend we send both a redlined PDF and a one-page summary of the approval flow to speed sign-off.

Suggested redline (publicity / reference):
"
Either party may identify the other as a customer or vendor in press releases or marketing materials; however, any use of customer trademarks, logos, or customer-identifiable quotations shall require prior written approval. Customer approval shall not be unreasonably withheld and shall be provided within five (5) business days of receipt of request. For pilot or pre-release engagements, the parties agree to an embargo period of thirty (30) days following public announcement unless otherwise agreed in writing.
"

Suggested redline (logo assets / approval flow):
"
Customer may provide logo and brand assets to Redwood for inclusion in promotional materials. Redwood will use only the provided assets and will submit proposed usages to the Customer for approval. Customer will respond within five (5) business days; failure to respond will be deemed approval. For clarity, approvals will be requested to the primary marketing contact and the legal contact listed on the order form.
"

Confidentiality: add clause explicitly carving out "Pilot data" as Confidential Information and restricts reference/quoting without consent.

I attached a short redline summary (redline_summary.docx) and the annotated order form (Brightware_OrderForm_redline.pdf) — both safe to send.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
